title: Join one after the other
description: Puts the connected inputs one after the other (in1, then in2, then in3 ...) with a gap between them: spoken phrases with a pause between, hits in a row. The gap is seconds plus beats; the result is as long as all parts and the gaps together.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the first input on unchanged.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.doc: Seconds of silence between two parts.

parameters.name: beats
parameters.doc: Beats of silence between two parts (added to the seconds).

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).
